meta.title: Execute
meta.description: The execution line: dispatch_task hands one task of the project graph to a subagent on a model the main agent names and justifies, the harness builds the worktree and the brief, the dispatched chain writes only inside its own worktree, write scope and branch, GLM dispatches try Start Plan first with automatic Coding Plan failover, and /dispatch-mode sets the project dispatch preference.
